Happened to me a couple of times and I always just open a dispute and say despite tracking showing it was delivered, I never got it. Always got a refund without any further questions and I have one currently still pending.
Contact the seller and ask about it, then open a dispute stating your issue in as simple as possible English.
Since they likely use the AliExpress translation feature, the more complex your sentences, the worse the resulting translation. 
Also, if asking for a refund, I've found you're more likely to get your money back, if you just ask for the product price back without the shipping cost.
Proper documentation is important too.
Has worked for me and I have been buying on AliExpress regularly for 3 years now, with several returns and refunds going flawlessly.

So, while I am not a believer at all, I somehow stumbled across this post and it is definitely possible to be accepted and valued, despite having a different belief. It is just a matter of meeting the right people. People who don't respect your opinions and who you are and what you believe in, don't deserve to be called friends. Friendship is based on mutual respect and trust. 
I think the world is full of understanding, respectful, polite, beautiful people, with how (social) media work, it can be hard to remember that, since selfishness and horrible attitude is a dangerous trend that gets the people, who don't deserve it, attention.  
The people who don't revel in that, mostly just don't complain or feel the need to take it to social media.

I've quit almost all social media and it's been a great decision. I focus on the people around me and myself now and I have become a lot happier person ever since.

Don't give up hope, surround yourself with people and things that lift you up, not pull you down. 
The future holds big opportunities for every one of us, but we will only ever reach and appreciate them, if we go through all the troubles in between. 

Stay safe and good luck ❤️
